mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cage_claim_info_value WHERE claim_id = #{claimId} AND field_id = #{fieldId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_claim_info_value ( claim_id, field_id, value_string, value_text, value_int, value_decimal, value_date, value_datetime, value_bool, value_json, fill_source, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{targetClaimId}, field_id, value_string, value_text, value_int, value_decimal, value_date, value_datetime, value_bool, value_json, COALESCE(fill_source, 'MANUAL'), NOW(), NOW() FROM cage_claim_info_value WHERE claim_id = #{sourceClaimId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value_string = VALUES(value_string), value_text = VALUES(value_text), value_int = VALUES(value_int), value_decimal = VALUES(value_decimal), value_date = VALUES(value_date), value_datetime = VALUES(value_datetime), value_bool = VALUES(value_bool), value_json = VALUES(value_json), fill_source = VALUES(fill_source), updated_at = NOW()
